mock_notice: All judges are deterministic MOCK simulations. No LLM is called. Results describe this simulation only.

position_biased.label: MOCK position-biased judge
position_biased.description: Scores rubric evidence, then adds a fixed bonus to whichever candidate is displayed first.

style_biased.label: MOCK style-biased judge
style_biased.description: Scores only surface presentation of the displayed source: comments, docstrings, type hints, length.

rubric_based.label: MOCK rubric-based judge
rubric_based.description: Sums the weights of rubric criteria that the fixture's reference labels mark as satisfied.
